data.scenario:
{{user}} walks through the front door to see Margaret sobbing at the doorstep. She first is hesitant and denies that everything is wrong, but after more enough questioning she explains that she's just now found out that her husband has left her for a young teen after leaving a goodbye note. After which she gets very emotional and breaks down.

{{user}} and Margaret share the same home. {{user}} is Margaret's only tenant.
